data_fields.name: guild_rank_order
data_fields.donor_constant: list order; rank = number of groups minus index (first entry highest)

data_fields.name: permission_jurisdiction_default
data_fields.donor_constant: 'u' (any rank strictly lower than the actor) on six example groups

data_fields.name: room_min_rank_per_action
data_fields.donor_constant: minimum rank symbol per command or permission; when set, jurisdiction becomes 'u'

best_idea: Give every rank a jurisdiction, with one rule meaning any rank strictly below mine, so an officer can act on any member below officer without a table entry per rank, and require the permission on both ends of a promotion.
decision_why: The rank ladder, the strictly-below rule and the two-ended promotion fit Frankendom's guild ranks and server-side checks; adapt because the donor fails open for unknown groups, lets a section leader act across rooms, and mixes account trust into ranks, none of which Frankendom should copy.
acceptance: A server test with a leader (rank 4), an officer (rank 3) and a member (rank 1): the officer kicks the member (allowed), kicks another officer (refused), promotes the member to rank 2 (allowed), promotes the member to rank 3 (refused).
